Build your Outline 📝 — "Create an outline for a 10-12 page guide about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Give me a chapter-by-chapter structure with a one-sentence summary for each section." 2. Write it ✍️ — "Write a short, conversational section about [SUBTOPIC]. Keep it simple, include one real-world example, under 250 words." Add your own voice after. 3. Name it — "Give me 10 name ideas for a guide about [TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE]. Mix descriptive and punchy, avoid clichés." 4. Design it in Canva 🎨 (a free tool) — search "ebook template," drop your content in, export as PDF. 5. Sell it — upload to Etsy, Stan Store, or Pensight.
